limitations: Single-person adaptation on visually sampled intervals with automatic boxes. Final-minute videos and teammate data excluded from training/selection.
recovery_method: Cached VIDEO boxes instead of repeated IMAGE-mode tracking; local archive extraction; workers0. Same label roles, replay recipe, epochs, learning rate and initial weights.

lighting_samples.review: All eight crop sheets inspected. Five ambiguous near-contact negatives excluded. Some positive fingertip contacts are occluded/blurred; positive labels retain independent-marker context and are weak labels.
